verdict.rationale: Orama documents a programmatic API for its open-source library, including database creation with schemas, insert and insertMultiple, search, facets, vector/hybrid search and AnswerSession. Orama Cloud ships official JS/TS, Python and Rust SDKs whose APIs are designed to mirror the open-source ones, plus a per-project MCP server and a machine-readable llms.txt, so the product can clearly be driven programmatically. missing for 10: a published OpenAPI/Swagger spec (all probed paths returned 404), explicit REST endpoint reference documentation in the pack, independent or hands-on corroboration.
